# Climate Action & Sustainability Commission Agenda

Tuesday, October 27, 2026 | 5:30PM | Virtual Meeting

Meeting Link: https://teams.microsoft.com/l/meetupjoin/19%3ameeting_YWQwMGVlMDMtYjBhYy00MzdmLWE1ZDItNGVjMDMwZmNlNDEw%40thread.v2/0?context=%7b%22Tid%22%3a%224a074cd1-7906-46af-b38f-90cd429d7f1b%22%2c%22Oid%22%3a%22651237f4-9307-4b52-8dcf-3f04c3fa328b%22%7d

## Roll Call (1 min)

## Minutes to be Approved (4 min)

Commission to approve minutes from September 14 meeting.

## Youth Climate Action Fund (YCAF) Application Review (50 min) - Ricky

- Outline the plan for award communication to applicants. (5 min)
- Group to discuss submitted applications.
  - Ricky to present data analysis regarding the group’s consolidated scores. (5 min)
  - Begin conversation with applications that had the widest ranging scores. (10 min)
  - Engage in tiered approach to awards (25 min):
    1. Look at applications that the group wants to fund as is.
    2. Look at applications that the group wants to fund at a reduced or different budget.
    3. If there are still funds left to award, look at the remaining applications and consider funding conditionally, based on edits to project or budget.
- Group to vote on award recommendations. (5 min)

## Next Steps (5 min)

- Consider dates for award announcement.
- Discuss agenda for next meeting.
  - For future meetings, consider YCAF debrief, MyRWA’s CLEANAIR presentation, Black Earth Compost.
- Schedule date/time for next meeting (the calendar invite falls on Veteran’s Day, so the group needs to reschedule).
- Share out any upcoming relevant events.

## Adjournment – 6:30PM

If you would like to request a reasonable accommodation, please contact Maria Luise, ADA Compliance Coordinator at mluise@cityofmalden.org or 781-397-7000 Ext. 2005

For instructions on enabling live translated captions in Teams, please visit: www.cityofmalden.org/captions
